description: This Dart file defines an AuthRepository class responsible for handling authentication processes such as login, logout, and token existence checks by delegating these actions to a remote data source.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: Repository class that manages authentication-related interactions with a remote data source, encapsulating login, logout, and token validation operations.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate using provided email and password, returning a Future<bool> indicating success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the authentication token by invoking the remote source logout function.

methods.name: hasToken
methods.description: Checks for the existence of an authentication token locally.
